name: mcx-desk
description: Skills and MCP tools for driving a running Motorcortex Desk tab — plot live controller signals and custom computed signals, control the view, capture screenshots, export CSV, analyze buffered samples, read statistics and FFT spectra. Requires Motorcortex Desk open in a browser. For parameter-tree work without plotting, use the mcx-core param skills.

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "Motorcortex Desk: Node.js is not installed, so the mcx-desk MCP server cannot start. Install Node.js 18 or newer (https://nodejs.org) and restart Claude Code."
